title: Kanbus for Mac
description:
Native SwiftUI application implementing the Kanbus console for Mac and iPad, verified against the shared @console Gherkin behavior specs. Replaces the web-based kbsc console with a native app that provides the same board visualization, issue detail, settings, standup, and wiki functionality.

The console specs in features/console/ are already platform-agnostic -- they test board logic (filtering, sorting, column visibility, metadata display) against an in-memory ConsoleState model, not against DOM or web rendering. Both the Python and Rust implementations verify console behavior without touching a browser. A SwiftUI app implementing the same ConsoleState model runs those exact specs unchanged.

Depends on KanbusKit for the domain model and business logic. The Mac app is a presentation layer over KanbusKit.
